payload.claim: The acceptance criterion requires the comment to cite §5.4 'and names no other section,' but the new witness (tests/test_contract.py:19-21) only rules out the one specific wrong citation that existed at base (§3.2) plus the §5.4.x overlap case. It never checks for an arbitrary additional section citation. Editing the comment to '# Versioned per module (DESIGN.md §5.4, also see §9.9). Only 1 exists today.' keeps every assertion in test_the_schema_version_comment_cites_the_gate_result_section green ('§5.4' in line, '§5.4.' not in line since it is followed by a comma, '§3.2' not in line) while the comment now names a second, spurious section, violating the stated criterion. This gap sits between a green suite and the criterion actually being met, and the gates (criteria: pass) report the criterion satisfied.
